conclusion: Among the candidates tested, the adopted small change beats Pinocchio 2.7.0 reduced-model gravity on Fetch and OpenArm in all three fresh processes. Margins are small. It loses on PR2 right arm. Global minimality and universal superiority are not established.

changes: Cache contributing COM indices for the current requested joint sequence; recompute only when that sequence changes.
Evaluate only COM poses needed by requested revolute joints. Prismatic joints use current mass only.
Rotate COM vectors directly with quaternions and retain only world XY coordinates.
Skip the moment sum for an exactly vertical revolute axis.
Copy contiguous native float64 Python input directly using the buffer protocol into one reusable Eigen vector; retain fallback conversion.
implementation.cache_lifetime: Topology indices only. Masses, angles and poses are read each call; no mass/pose invalidation protocol is needed. Added links are massless.
implementation.unchanged: Core FK, get_link_pose, joint setters, RelevancePredicateTable, public gravity signatures and result ownership.
implementation.remaining_allocations: Gravity output and per-call COM XY workspace remain local; only the Python input vector is reused.

measurement.pinocchio_build: Existing 2.7.0 wheel; compiler flags not verified
measurement.method: Median of 15 batch means by default; Python calls and returned array costs included. 256 changing configurations, accurate=True. Model setup, Pinocchio q conversion and output reordering excluded. Same interpreter, pinned CPU, sequential shuffled batches, GC disabled. The Pinocchio reduced model is built before timing. Pinocchio gravity sign is reversed only in correctness checks, outside timing.
measurement.scope: Warm repeated calls with fixed requested joints and changing q. Selection preparation is outside timing; changing the joint selection incurs rebuilding the index lists. Python API timings include binding and result-array costs; these are not native kernel-only comparisons.

tests.full_suite: 170 passed, 17 existing SciPy warnings; numpy.random.seed(0), pytest tests -q.
tests.correctness: Compared to independent legacy gravity formula and sign-corrected Pinocchio at atol=rtol=1e-10. Tests cover mass updates, arbitrary selected joints/order/duplicates, nonselected joint motion, base rotation, added links, approximate FK, dtype/layout fallbacks, input resize and output ownership.
tests.core_source_check: Core FK and setter implementation verified unchanged from baseline.
tests.imported_binary: build/native extension SHA-256 matches all three adopted measured runs.
tests.formatting: clang-format 14 Chromium output matches changed C++ files; black, isort, flake8 and git diff --check pass.

excluded_models.PandaSpec: Local URDF has no inertial links; excluded from meaningful gravity timing.

reproduction_notes: Run from repository root after the documented incremental Release build and extension link. Run each benchmark process sequentially; repeat the default condition three times. A --robots option was added to the existing harness without changing its measurement method; the recorded PR2 run used a local copy whose model list was changed to PR2RarmSpec.
